rows.en: Come to think of it, the enemy reinforcements called themselves the something-or-other Army.
If I remember right... Nega... Nega...
Negataros!?
That's the one.
I see. Negataros and Bogarl...
And the Weather Dopant who rules them... Now we're getting a picture of the enemy's organization.
All right, everyone. Let's go out and search again.
We won't find Mebius by sitting here talking... Right?
Let me go.
This is my responsibility. It's because I acted so selfishly...
Hikari!!
If you go now, you'll only repeat the same mistake!
Don't you understand that?
...You're right. I'm sorry.
I'll take charge of maintaining the base. I'll support you all from here.
Yeah. That's reassuring.
I'm counting on you to bring Mebius back.
There's a Ride Vendor up ahead.
"BANG! BANG!"
"BANG! BANG!"
Tch!! Damn thing's messing with me!
"BANG! BANG!"
Ankh was pounding on the Ride Vendor.
This Ride Vendor's busted...
Give me back my Cell Medals!! You know how many I put in there!?
Ankh! Cut that out! You can't take it out on things... What on earth happened?
What in the world happened?
...I lost track of that Yummy.
I wanted to have a Candroid track the Yummy, but...
I wanted to get something tracking it right away, but...
Hmph! Useless right when I need it!!
There are other Ride Vendors. We just need to find one that works, right?
Then, OOO...
Help me out.
What kind of attitude is that!
(...No, wait. The Siamese Cat Yummy works for Negataros...
...which means it might lead us to a clue about Mebius.)
Oh, all right. Let's look for one together.
What? You're awfully agreeable all of a sudden. It's creepy... Whatever, let's hurry!
Ankh! Quit taking it out on things!
What on earth happened?
Ankh! Quit taking it out on things!
What on earth happened?
Ankh! Quit taking it out on things!
What on earth happened?
Ankh! Knock it off! Don't take it out on things!
What on earth happened?
Tch...! I lost track of that Yummy.
I wanted to have a Candroid track the Yummy, but...
I wanted to use this thing to track it, but...
Hmph! Useless right when I need it!!
Ankh, there are other Ride Vendors. Let's find one that works.
We want to know where Negataros went too.
Yeah, that Yummy's one of his underlings. We might turn up a lead.
There are other Ride Vendors. Let's find one that works.
We want to know where Negataros went too.
That Yummy's one of his underlings. We might turn up a lead.
There are other Ride Vendors. Let's find one that works.
We want to know where Negataros went too.
That Yummy's one of his underlings. We might turn up a lead.
There are other Ride Vendors. Let's go find one that works.
We want to know where Negataros went too.
That Yummy's one of his underlings. We might turn up a lead.
Hah!? Looks like this Ride Vendor actually works.
Tch!! Damn it!!
I blew every Cell Medal I had on that last Ride Vendor.
You... wouldn't happen to have any Cell Medals on you, would you?
I see... Well, that's too bad.
You've got some, don't you? Hand them over already.
{8074} gave Ankh the Cell Medals they had on hand.
Hoh... You're more useful than I thought.
Then I'll be taking these Cell Medals.
"CLINK!"
"BEEP!"
"CLUNK!!"
"TAKA CAN!!"
All right... Time to boot it up...
"CLICK, CLACK... WHIRR, WHIRR, WHIRR..."
Peep, peep...
All right, go find that Yummy.

notes.note: Speakers for 0128 #0.24-0.40 not recovered. From context: Hikari gives the clue (0.24-0.25, 0.27), asks to go (0.32-0.33), apologises and takes over the base (0.37-0.38, 0.40). The other lines belong to the team/leader and are kept speaker-neutral. 'something-or-other Army' = Hikari half-remembering Negataros's army name.
Hikari blames his own reckless solo pursuit of Bogal (story_010). Sentence deliberately trails off.
Speaker unknown; uses polite 'anata', so likely a polite party member. 0.36 reads as a separate, blunter speaker (source has a missing particle; meaning clear).
Direction: Hikari asking the team to rescue Mebius, not offering himself.
Ankh cursing the broken vending machine ('fuzakeyagatte'); rendered as frustration at the machine.
No speaker; alternate (probably party-variant) version of the question in 0.8. Same for 0.12 (variant of 0.11) and 0.33 (variant of 0.32; 'koitsu' read as this vending machine).
'That Yummy' = the Siamese Cat Yummy (named in 0.18).
0.23-0.46: branch when OOO is not in the party; W / Nu Gundam / Zeta Gundam / Zero variants of the same lines. 0.37 'his' = Negataros.
0.6 and 0.7 have no speaker; Ankh reacting to the player's 'no' answer (0.6 accepting it, 0.7 not believing it).
{8074} = player/team name variable; neutral 'they'. Padding removed per brief.
Ride Vendor's voice announcing the Taka Candroid ('Taka Can'), as in Kamen Rider OOO.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers for 0128 #0.24-0.40 not recovered; inferred from context (Hikari's lines clear, others kept neutral). Unlabelled variant rows 0130 #0.9/0.12/0.33 and 0131 #0.6/0.7 inferred. Terms not in glossary: Ride Vendor, Candroid (established OOO English names, as in story_003), 'Taka Can' (vendor voice).
